name: Fighter
description: A master of arms in every sense. Fighters out-train everyone else on the field, striking more often, wearing heavier steel, and standing when the plan has fallen apart.
full: The fighter is the class that simply out-fights everyone. No pact, no bloodline, no deity: only training taken further than anyone else was willing to take it, until the ordinary act of hitting something becomes overwhelming through sheer volume and precision.

Extra Attack scales further than any other class, Action Surge buys a whole extra turn at the moment it decides a fight, and Second Wind keeps them standing. The subclass supplies the flavour, whether that is battlefield manoeuvres, arcane spellcasting, or simply critting more often than should be possible.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a style of combat such as Archery, Defense, Duelling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection or Two-Weapon Fighting. You cannot take the same option twice.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Recharges on a short or long rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn, beyond your normal action and bonus action. Recharges on a short or long rest, and you gain a second use at 17th level.

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.description: Choose the archetype your training follows. It grants features at 3rd, 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, 16th and 19th level, more often than any other class.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: Reroll a saving throw you fail, and use the new roll. Recharges on a long rest, with a second use at 13th level and a third at 17th.

features.name: Extra Attack (Two)
features.description: You attack three times, instead of twice, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Extra Attack (Three)
features.description: You attack four times, instead of three, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
